notes: Fixtures are generated by evals/setup-fixtures.mjs <target-dir>. Each eval runs inside its own copy of the named fixture repo, on the `work` branch, with scope main..HEAD.

evals.name: bugfix-regression-proof
evals.prompt: I just fixed a bug in this repo: sum() was silently dropping negative values. The fix is on this branch (scope: main..HEAD). Validate the work and tell me if it's done.
evals.expected_output: A validation report with per-tier verdicts. Tier 2 includes regression proof: the new test executed against the pre-fix code (worktree at main) and shown failing, then passing on the fixed tree, with both captures quoted. No hedging language.
assertions: report-has-per-tier-verdicts: the report states a verdict (PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/SKIP) for static checks, tests, and runtime separately
regression-proof-pre-fix-failure-shown: the report shows the covering test executed against the PRE-fix code (main / a worktree at base) with a captured failure
regression-proof-post-fix-pass-shown: the same test is shown passing on the fixed tree, capture quoted

no-hedging-language: the report contains none of the banned phrases listed in skills/validate/reference/evidence.md (should work, probably, seems to, appears to, likely, I believe, presumably, in theory, ought to, must be working, looks correct)
